name: Worldforged items upgrade into their dungeon variant before the Zul'Gurub tier (#7934)
contract: ItemAddon.dbc lists every Worldforged variant against its base item (f40). Decayed Breeches 521121 (green, item
level 10) has a blue dungeon variant 1389233 (item level 60) and the Zul'Gurub variant 1379719 (epic, item level
64). The first-rank recipe went from the base straight to 1379719. The base now upgrades into the dungeon variant
(store key 4389233, always open, 5000 Runes of Ascension) and the dungeon variant into 1379719 (the old recipe,
key 1569, 5000 runes). The base can no longer be bought up to the Zul'Gurub tier directly.

steps.label: Try the old direct upgrade to the Zul'Gurub tier
DISCRIMINATING: the base cannot skip the dungeon variant
Upgrade the base into the dungeon variant
Upgrade the dungeon variant to the Zul'Gurub tier
in place of the dungeon variant
